profile_text: With a specialization in woodworking and furniture manufacturing, this Düsseldorf-based carpentry company has experienced significant growth, increasing its workforce by 40% since the baseline. As a leading provider of custom woodworking solutions, its expertise in crafting high-quality furniture has driven demand and expansion. Operating with 14 employees as of 2024, the company's focus on precision and craftsmanship has enabled it to scale effectively in the manufacturing sector.
